dialogue.text: Hi everybody and welcome to this video. We're going to talk about how to use these and those.
dialogue.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這個影片。我們將會談論如何使用 these 和 those。
dialogue.ja: みなさん、こんにちは。この動画へようこそ。今日は these と those の使い方について話します。
dialogue.local: Hi everybody and welcome to this video. We're going to talk about how to use these and those.
dialogue.en: Hi everybody and welcome to this video. We're going to talk about how to use these and those.

dialogue.text: Okay. Just like we learned with this and that, we use these and those to talk about nouns that are close to us or far from us.
dialogue.zh: 好的，就像我們學過 this 和 that 一樣，我們用 these 和 those 來談論離我們近或遠的名詞。
dialogue.ja: はい。this と that を学んだように、these と those は私たちに近いか遠い名詞について話すときに使います。
dialogue.local: Okay. Just like we learned with this and that, we use these and those to talk about nouns that are close to us or far from us.
dialogue.en: Okay. Just like we learned with this and that, we use these and those to talk about nouns that are close to us or far from us.

dialogue.text: Okay. So let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.zh: 好的，那我們來看看黑板。
dialogue.ja: では、黒板を見てみましょう。
dialogue.local: Okay. So let's take a look at the board.
dialogue.en: Okay. So let's take a look at the board.

dialogue.text: Now we know if there's just one and it's close to us, we say this is a flower.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們知道，如果只有一個且離我們很近，我們說 this is a flower。
dialogue.ja: 今、もし一つだけで私たちに近ければ、this is a flower と言います。
dialogue.local: Now we know if there's just one and it's close to us, we say this is a flower.
dialogue.en: Now we know if there's just one and it's close to us, we say this is a flower.

dialogue.text: Okay. But there's more than one. It's plural. So we have to say these. These are flowers.
dialogue.zh: 好的，但如果不只一個，是複數，我們就要說 these。These are flowers。
dialogue.ja: はい。でも一つ以上で複数なら、these を使います。These are flowers と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. But there's more than one. It's plural. So we have to say these. These are flowers.
dialogue.en: Okay. But there's more than one. It's plural. So we have to say these. These are flowers.

dialogue.text: Again more than one. Now I changed the B verb to R and I added an S at the end of flower. So these are flowers.
dialogue.zh: 又是複數。現在我把 be 動詞改成 are，並在 flower 後面加了 s，所以是 these are flowers。
dialogue.ja: また複数です。be 動詞を are に変えて、flower の後ろに s をつけました。だから these are flowers です。
dialogue.local: Again more than one. Now I changed the B verb to R and I added an S at the end of flower. So these are flowers.
dialogue.en: Again more than one. Now I changed the B verb to R and I added an S at the end of flower. So these are flowers.

dialogue.text: Okay. Now there's one that's far away. We say that is a flower but again there's more than one.
dialogue.zh: 好的，現在有一個在遠處，我們說 that is a flower，但如果不只一個，
dialogue.ja: はい。今度は遠くに一つあります。that is a flower と言いますが、複数の場合は、
dialogue.local: Okay. Now there's one that's far away. We say that is a flower but again there's more than one.
dialogue.en: Okay. Now there's one that's far away. We say that is a flower but again there's more than one.

dialogue.text: There are two flowers. So in that case we use those are flowers. Those are flowers. They're far away.
dialogue.zh: 有兩朵花，所以我們用 those are flowers。Those are flowers，它們在遠處。
dialogue.ja: 花が二つあります。その場合は those are flowers を使います。Those are flowers。遠くにあります。
dialogue.local: There are two flowers. So in that case we use those are flowers. Those are flowers. They're far away.
dialogue.en: There are two flowers. So in that case we use those are flowers. Those are flowers. They're far away.

dialogue.text: Those are flowers. Let's look at these. This is a marker. These are markers.
dialogue.zh: Those are flowers。讓我們看看這些。This is a marker。These are markers。
dialogue.ja: Those are flowers。これらを見てみましょう。This is a marker。These are markers。
dialogue.local: Those are flowers. Let's look at these. This is a marker. These are markers.
dialogue.en: Those are flowers. Let's look at these. This is a marker. These are markers.

dialogue.text: That is a marker. Those are markers.
dialogue.zh: That is a marker。Those are markers。
dialogue.ja: That is a marker。Those are markers。
dialogue.local: That is a marker. Those are markers.
dialogue.en: That is a marker. Those are markers.

dialogue.text: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. So we know these are flowers. They're close by and for the flowers that are far away we say those are flowers.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們繼續下一部分。我們知道這些是花，它們很近；遠處的花我們說 those are flowers。
dialogue.ja: はい。次の部分に進みましょう。これらは花で近くにあります。遠くの花は those are flowers と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. So we know these are flowers. They're close by and for the flowers that are far away we say those are flowers.
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. So we know these are flowers. They're close by and for the flowers that are far away we say those are flowers.

dialogue.text: Okay. But over here we have chairs. So we have to use the negative.
dialogue.zh: 好的，但這裡有椅子，所以我們要用否定句。
dialogue.ja: はい。でもここには椅子があります。だから否定形を使います。
dialogue.local: Okay. But over here we have chairs. So we have to use the negative.
dialogue.en: Okay. But over here we have chairs. So we have to use the negative.

dialogue.text: Okay. We use the contraction aren't which is short for are not. These aren't flowers.
dialogue.zh: 我們用縮寫 aren't，代表 are not。These aren't flowers。
dialogue.ja: aren't は are not の短縮形です。These aren't flowers と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. We use the contraction aren't which is short for are not. These aren't flowers.
dialogue.en: Okay. We use the contraction aren't which is short for are not. These aren't flowers.

dialogue.text: These aren't flowers.
dialogue.zh: These 不是花。
dialogue.ja: These aren't flowers。
dialogue.local: These aren't flowers.
dialogue.en: These aren't flowers.

dialogue.text: Okay. And for the chairs that are far away we say those aren't flowers.
dialogue.zh: 好的，遠處的椅子我們說 those aren't flowers。
dialogue.ja: はい。遠くの椅子は those aren't flowers と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. And for the chairs that are far away we say those aren't flowers.
dialogue.en: Okay. And for the chairs that are far away we say those aren't flowers.

dialogue.text: Those aren't flowers.
dialogue.zh: Those 不是花。
dialogue.ja: Those aren't flowers。
dialogue.local: Those aren't flowers.
dialogue.en: Those aren't flowers.

dialogue.text: Okay. And let's try with the markers. These aren't pens.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們來試試看標記筆。These 不是筆。
dialogue.ja: はい。マーカーで試してみましょう。These aren't pens。
dialogue.local: Okay. And let's try with the markers. These aren't pens.
dialogue.en: Okay. And let's try with the markers. These aren't pens.

dialogue.text: These aren't pens.
dialogue.zh: These 不是筆。
dialogue.ja: These aren't pens。
dialogue.local: These aren't pens.
dialogue.en: These aren't pens.

dialogue.text: Okay. And for away those aren't pens.
dialogue.zh: 好的，遠處的那些不是筆。
dialogue.ja: はい。遠くのものは those aren't pens と言います。
dialogue.local: Okay. And for away those aren't pens.
dialogue.en: Okay. And for away those aren't pens.

dialogue.text: Those aren't pens.
dialogue.zh: Those 不是筆。
dialogue.ja: Those aren't pens。
dialogue.local: Those aren't pens.
dialogue.en: Those aren't pens.

dialogue.text: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. Now we're going to make some questions.
dialogue.zh: 好的，我們繼續下一部分。現在我們要來造一些疑問句。
dialogue.ja: はい。次の部分に進みましょう。今度は質問文を作ります。
dialogue.local: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. Now we're going to make some questions.
dialogue.en: Okay. Let's move on to the next part. Now we're going to make some questions.

dialogue.text: We know these are flowers. When you want to make a question you have to change these are and put the be verb first.
dialogue.zh: 我們知道 these are flowers。要造疑問句時，要把 these are 改成把 be 動詞放前面。
dialogue.ja: これらは花です。質問文を作るときは、these are を変えて be 動詞を前に置きます。
dialogue.local: We know these are flowers. When you want to make a question you have to change these are and put the be verb first.
dialogue.en: We know these are flowers. When you want to make a question you have to change these are and put the be verb first.

dialogue.text: So it becomes are these flowers? Are these flowers?
dialogue.zh: 所以變成 are these flowers? Are these flowers?
dialogue.ja: だから、are these flowers? となります。Are these flowers?
dialogue.local: So it becomes are these flowers? Are these flowers?
dialogue.en: So it becomes are these flowers? Are these flowers?

dialogue.text: And the answer is yes they are.
dialogue.zh: 答案是 yes, they are。
dialogue.ja: 答えは yes, they are です。
dialogue.local: And the answer is yes they are.
dialogue.en: And the answer is yes they are.

dialogue.text: Now the flowers are far away. So we say are those flowers? Are those flowers?
dialogue.zh: 現在花在遠處，所以我們說 are those flowers? Are those flowers?
dialogue.ja: 今度は花が遠くにあります。だから are those flowers? と言います。Are those flowers?
dialogue.local: Now the flowers are far away. So we say are those flowers? Are those flowers?
dialogue.en: Now the flowers are far away. So we say are those flowers? Are those flowers?

dialogue.text: And again the answer is yes they are.
dialogue.zh: 答案還是 yes, they are。
dialogue.ja: 答えはまた yes, they are です。
dialogue.local: And again the answer is yes they are.
dialogue.en: And again the answer is yes they are.

dialogue.text: Okay. Now here we have chairs. Are these flowers? The answer is no they aren't.
dialogue.zh: 好的，這裡有椅子。Are these flowers? 答案是 no, they aren't。
dialogue.ja: はい。ここには椅子があります。Are these flowers? 答えは no, they aren't です。
dialogue.local: Okay. Now here we have chairs. Are these flowers? The answer is no they aren't.
dialogue.en: Okay. Now here we have chairs. Are these flowers? The answer is no they aren't.

dialogue.text: Okay. And now they're far away. Are those flowers? And again the answer is no they aren't.
dialogue.zh: 好的，現在椅子在遠處。Are those flowers? 答案還是 no, they aren't。
dialogue.ja: はい。今度は遠くにあります。Are those flowers? 答えはまた no, they aren't です。
dialogue.local: Okay. And now they're far away. Are those flowers? And again the answer is no they aren't.
dialogue.en: Okay. And now they're far away. Are those flowers? And again the answer is no they aren't.

dialogue.text: How about these? Are these markers? Yes they are.
dialogue.zh: 這些呢？Are these markers? 答案是 yes, they are。
dialogue.ja: これらはどうですか？Are these markers? 答えは yes, they are です。
dialogue.local: How about these? Are these markers? Yes they are.
dialogue.en: How about these? Are these markers? Yes they are.

dialogue.text: Are those markers? Yes they are.
dialogue.zh: Are those markers? 答案是 yes, they are。
dialogue.ja: Are those markers? 答えは yes, they are です。
dialogue.local: Are those markers? Yes they are.
dialogue.en: Are those markers? Yes they are.

dialogue.text: Are these pens? No they aren't.
dialogue.zh: Are these pens? 答案是 no, they aren't。
dialogue.ja: Are these pens? 答えは no, they aren't です。
dialogue.local: Are these pens? No they aren't.
dialogue.en: Are these pens? No they aren't.

dialogue.text: Are those pens? No they aren't.
dialogue.zh: Are those pens? 答案是 no, they aren't。
dialogue.ja: Are those pens? 答えは no, they aren't です。
dialogue.local: Are those pens? No they aren't.
dialogue.en: Are those pens? No they aren't.

dialogue.text: Okay. So in this video we learned how to use these and those. I hope you guys understand and I'll see you in the next video. Bye!
dialogue.zh: 好的，這個影片我們學會了如何使用 these 和 those。希望大家都懂了，下次影片見，再見！
dialogue.ja: はい。この動画で these と those の使い方を学びました。みなさん分かってくれるといいです。次の動画で会いましょう。さようなら！
dialogue.local: Okay. So in this video we learned how to use these and those. I hope you guys understand and I'll see you in the next video. Bye!
dialogue.en: Okay. So in this video we learned how to use these and those. I hope you guys understand and I'll see you in the next video. Bye!
